# A public-domain sample in the transcription format. CI imports it into a fresh database
# twice and checks the result with expect_sample_book.sql.

SECTION Service Music

HYMN
Title: Doxology
Tune: Old Hundredth
Words: Thomas Ken, 1637-1711
Music: Louis Bourgeois, c. 1510-c. 1561

Praise God, from whom all blessings flow;
Praise Him, all creatures here below;
Praise Him above, ye heav'nly host;
Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost. Amen.

TOPIC Communion

HYMN
Title: Let Us Break Bread Together
Words: Traditional

1
Let us break bread together on our knees.


SECTION Hymns

HYMN 1
Title: Rock of Ages
Words: Augustus M. Toplady, 1740-1778

1
Rock of Ages, cleft for me, Let me hide myself in Thee;

2
Not the labours of my hands Can fulfil Thy law's demands;

HYMN 2
Title: A Protected Hymn
Words: A. Living Writer, 1950-

1
These words are still under copyright.


SECTION Supplementary Hymns

HYMN 001
Title: Blessed Assurance
Words: Fanny J. Crosby, 1820-1915

1
Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine! O what a foretaste of glory divine!

CHORUS
This is my story, this is my song, Praising my Saviour all the day long.


READING 11
Title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
Scripture: Psalm 23

Leader: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
People: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures.
Ref: Psalm 23:1-2
All: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life.

READING 12
Title: Benedictions
Kind: benedictions

1. The Lord bless thee, and keep thee.
Ref: Numbers 6:24

2. The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
Ref: II Corinthians 13:14

READING 13
Title: Unfinished Reading
Status: draft

Leader: Only the first line so far.

CREED
Title: The Apostles' Creed

I believe in God the Father Almighty, maker of heaven and earth.

COVENANT
Title: The Church Covenant

Having been led, as we believe, by the Spirit of God:

1. **We engage, therefore:**
- to **walk** together in Christian love;
- to **strive** for the advancement of this church.
